capabilities: highlight adjectives, nouns, adverbs, verbs, and conjunctions in the editor
toggle highlighting on or off via a command
problem: Obsidian's editor has no way to visually distinguish parts of speech while writing, unlike tools such as iA Writer.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the compromise natural language processing library to detect parts of speech.

summary: Editor plugin that highlights parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, conjunctions) in notes with customizable colors.
